newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Gunmen kidnap Nicaraguan working for EU.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kidnap Nicaraguan working for EU.

text.p: A group of heavily armed men kidnapped a Nicaraguan working for the European Union in northern Nicaragua, police officials said on Tuesday.
Armando Ortiz, 44, was seized on Monday by six gunmen who stopped the car he was travelling in with four other people in El Ocote, some 93 miles (150 km) north of the capital.

The other men were released, but the gunmen hauled away Ortiz, who works as an accountant for a European Union (EU) mission in Nicaragua and was in charge of EU projects in the northern region of the country, police said.

"There were five people travelling in the vehicle, which was marked with an EU logo, when they were intercepted by six uniformed men," said Francisco Lopez, a police official in the Matagalpa province.
"The remainder of the people were set free so they could tell police and the army," he said.
Local newspapers said the kidnappers probably belonged to ragtag gangs left over from the Contra rebel movement of the 1980s.
